title: Visitor guide frame
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Local area, holiday and travel: town, region and country; holidays (2.3, 2.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 24 (Visitor guide frame (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 24: My town: places to see and things to do. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

head: Arabic
English
rows: there is a museum in my town
it does not have an airport

panels.title: Places to see
points: مَعَالِمُ مَدِينَتِي: the sights of my town

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: After أَنْ the verb ends in fathah: تَزُورَ، تَتَجَوَّلَ، تَقْرَأَ
يُوجَدُ فِي مَدِينَتِي + the place. لٰكِنْ (but). لَا يُوجَدُ فِيهَا + the missing place.

questions.q: Say: There is a big park in my town, but there is no cinema.
questions.a: يُوجَدُ فِي مَدِينَتِي حَدِيقَةٌ كَبِيرَةٌ، لٰكِنْ لَا يُوجَدُ فِيهَا سِينَمَا.

questions.q: Suggest to a female visitor: you can visit the museum.
Core: Write a 90-word guide for an Arabic-speaking visitor (portal response box): what there is, what there is not, three suggestions with يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ, and your favourite place with a reason.
questions.a: Marked for يُوجَدُ / لَا يُوجَدُ, subjunctive after أَنْ, places, opinion with reason.

questions.q: Extend (Group B): prepare the role play line: 'Excuse me, what is there to do here?' and two answers.
questions.a: عَفْوًا، مَاذَا يُمْكِنُ أَنْ أَفْعَلَ هُنَا؟ يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تَزُورَ ... / يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تَتَسَوَّقَ ...

questions.q: Stretch (Group A): give the i'rab of تَزُورَ in يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تَزُورَ.
questions.a: فِعْلٌ مُضَارِعٌ مَنْصُوبٌ بِأَنْ وَعَلَامَةُ نَصْبِهِ الفَتْحَةُ
B) يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تَزُورَ القَلْعَةَ. After أَنْ the present verb takes fathah: تَزُورَ.

questions.q: 'There is not': A) لَا يُوجَدُ B) يُوجَدُ C) يُمْكِنُ
Big question: suggest one thing a visitor can do in your town.
questions.a: For example: يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تَزُورَ المَسْجِدَ الكَبِيرَ.
